A compilation of current job postings on professional networking and employment platforms indicates multiple openings for administrative roles across various industries in the San Francisco Bay Area. The listings reflect opportunities spanning healthcare, defense, construction, banking, and community services.

Overview of Openings and Employers

The available positions span numerous cities and organizations throughout the region. Notable employers listed in the current hiring cycle include:

  • Healthcare and Community Services: Partnership HealthPlan of California (Santa Rosa and Fairfield), Hamilton Families (San Francisco), Front Porch Communities & Services (Oakland and Palo Alto), Regional Center of the East Bay (San Leandro), DaVita Kidney Care (Vallejo and San Francisco), Buckelew Programs Inc (Novato), and UCSF (San Francisco).
  • Corporate, Financial, and Legal: U.S. Bank (San Jose), Columbia Threadneedle Investments (Menlo Park), Bernstein Private Wealth Management (San Francisco), First Citizens Bank (Napa), Bank of America (San Francisco), BMO U.S. (San Francisco), Cooley LLP (Palo Alto), and Jenner & Block (San Francisco Bay Area).
  • Defense, Engineering, and Technology: Northrop Grumman (Sunnyvale), Lockheed Martin (Sunnyvale), The Walsh Group (Concord), Rosendin (San Jose), Nutanix (San Jose), Qualcomm (Santa Clara), and IXL Learning (San Mateo).
